id: W:fanon|toward the african revolution
original_title: Pour la révolution africaine : écrits politiques
note: Haakon Chevalier’s 1967 English translation of the 1964 French collection. Prefer the French original over graph translations w-231103 and w-231104.

id: W:lynch|godparents and kinship in early medieval europe
original_title: Godparents and Kinship in Early Medieval Europe
note: Joseph H. Lynch’s Princeton University Press monograph; no candidate works supplied. Original-edition LCCN confirmed in the library catalogue.

id: W:karila cohen|letat des esprits
original_title: L’État des esprits : l’invention de l’enquête politique en France (1814-1848)
note: Pierre Karila-Cohen’s French monograph, Presses universitaires de Rennes, collection Carnot; no candidates supplied.

id: W:baillie|letters and journals of robert baillie
original_title: The Letters and Journals of Robert Baillie, 1637-1662
note: Shortened citation of the same three-volume edition edited by David Laing, Edinburgh, 1841–1842.

id: W:geoffrey of monmouth|history of the kings of britain
note: Geoffrey of Monmouth’s Latin history, completed circa 1136. OCLC identifies the 1966 Penguin English translation by Lewis Thorpe; translator is inferred from the citation year, not specified in the citation.

id: W:king|life and correspondence of rufus king
original_title: The Life and Correspondence of Rufus King: Comprising His Letters, Private and Official, His Public Documents, and His Speeches
note: Six-volume collection published 1894–1900 by G. P. Putnam’s Sons. Charles R. King is the editor of Rufus King’s papers, not their original author; no candidates supplied.

id: W:benjamin|walter benjamin
note: Title repeats the author’s name and does not identify a work. Possibly a truncated citation to Walter Benjamin: Selected Writings, whose volume 2 paperback parts appeared in 2005, but no volume, editor, or publisher establishes this. No candidate or identifier assigned.

id: W:hunter|science and society in restoration england
original_title: Science and Society in Restoration England
note: Michael Hunter’s Cambridge University Press monograph; absent from the supplied corpus. ISBN of the original edition confirmed in the British national bibliography listing.

id: W:pierson|increasing returns path dependence and the study of politics|a
original_title: Increasing Returns, Path Dependence, and the Study of Politics
note: Journal article, not the later book Politics in Time (w-377210); no candidate represents this article.

id: W:bannister|canada as counter revolution|a
original_title: Canada as Counter-Revolution: The Loyalist Order Framework in Canadian History, 1750–1840
container: Jean-François Constant and Michel Ducharme, eds., Liberalism and Hegemony: Debating the Canadian Liberal Revolution (University of Toronto Press, 2009), pp. 98–146
note: Bannister’s chapter in Liberalism and Hegemony, not The Loyal Atlantic or another candidate. Chapter DOI confirmed in the publisher-deposited Crossref record.

id: W:steele|anointed the appointed and the elected|a
original_title: The Anointed, the Appointed, and the Elected: Governance of the British Empire, 1689–1784
container: P. J. Marshall, ed., The Oxford History of the British Empire, Volume II: The Eighteenth Century (Oxford University Press, 1998), pp. 105–127
note: Ian K. Steele’s chapter 5 in the Oxford History; distinct from all candidate works.

id: W:levine|introduction|a
container: Philippa Levine, ed., Gender and Empire (Oxford University Press, 2004), pp. 1–13
note: Introduction chapter, not the entire candidate collection w-1131703. Originally published in 2004; the publisher’s DOI page describes the 2007 edition.

id: W:franquet|voyages et memoires sur le canada
original_title: Voyages et mémoires sur le Canada
note: Louis Franquet’s 1752–1753 travel memoirs, first printed at Québec in 1889. McGill’s archival catalogue explicitly links the work to OCLC 49159386; the linked manifestation was not independently inspected. No candidates supplied.

id: W:howison|sketches of upper canada domestic local and characteristic
original_title: Sketches of Upper Canada, Domestic, Local, and Characteristic: To Which Are Added, Practical Details for the Information of Emigrants of Every Class; and Some Recollections of the United States of America
note: The 1821 first edition is the same work as the graph’s 1822 second edition. Choose the earlier graph record w-352141 rather than the 1970 reprint w-352142.

id: W:canada|debates
original_title: House of Commons Debates, Official Report
container: Canada, Parliament, House of Commons: official debates (Hansard); cited year 1950, session and volume unspecified
note: An ongoing parliamentary serial, not a single authored monograph. Official Commons reporting began in 1875. The citation does not identify a particular 1950 volume or sitting; kind book is only a schema approximation for bound debates. No edition identifier assigned.

id: W:keenleyside|memoirs of hugh l
container: Memoirs of Hugh L. Keenleyside, volume 2
note: Volume 2 of Keenleyside’s memoirs, McClelland and Stewart, 1982, 647 pages. The cited year 1981 is incorrect for this volume; no candidates supplied.

id: W:berger|introduction|a
container: Goldwin Smith, Canada and the Canadian Question (University of Toronto Press, 1971), pp. v–xx [possible container]
note: Possibly Berger’s introduction to Goldwin Smith’s book, verified in the publisher’s contents. The bare title and 2015 date do not establish the container; identification remains provisional. DOI identifies this possible chapter, not a confirmed resolution of the citation.

id: W:auger|on the brink of civil war|a
original_title: On the Brink of Civil War: The Canadian Government and the Suppression of the 1918 Quebec Easter Riots
note: Martin F. Auger’s journal article; no candidates supplied. DOI, publication date, and page range also confirmed in the publisher-deposited Crossref record.

id: W:green|making space for indigenous feminism
note: Edited collection, Joyce Green, editor; first edition, Fernwood Publishing, January 2007. No candidates supplied.

id: W:newton|feminist challenge to the canadian left 1900 1918
original_title: The Feminist Challenge to the Canadian Left, 1900–1918
note: Janice Newton’s English-language monograph, McGill-Queen’s University Press, 1995; no candidates supplied. OCLC identifies the catalogued electronic edition of this work.
